def create_qaoa_graph(graph_vertices, graph_edges):
    """Create a graph represented as an adjacency matrix."""
    graph = {}
    for i in range(len(graph_vertices)):
        graph[graph_vertices[i]] = []
    for edge in graph_edges:
        graph[edge[0]].append(edge[1])
        graph[edge[1]].append(edge[0])
    graph_adjacency = np.zeros((len(graph_vertices), len(graph_vertices)))
    for i in range(len(graph_vertices)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(graph_vertices)):
            graph_adjacency[i, j] = 1 if graph_vertices[i] in graph[graph_vertices[j]] else 0
            graph_adjacency[j, i] = graph_adjacency[i, j]
    return graph_adjacency

        circuit.x(qubit_register[i])
    return circuit
